notes: New: a ☰ menu with a News page, and a heads-up when new songs are added.
details: New ☰ button next to the search bar. It opens a side menu with News and Vspo (the main screen).
News lists every app update and every batch of new songs, newest first, with dates.
Tap a News card to see everything that changed in that update, or the full list of new songs.
When new songs are added, a pop-up shows them the next time you open the app.
Tap a song in any of these pop-ups to play it.
The update pop-up now shows just the main changes. The full list is in News.

notes: New: a Queue tab, and search inside playlists.
details: The footer now has three tabs: Library, Queue and Playlists.
Queue shows the song playing now, a big progress bar, and everything coming up next.
Tap ✕ next to an upcoming song to take it out of the queue.
Queue also previews (dimmed) what plays after the queue loops.
Tapping the mini-player opens the Queue tab.
Search inside a playlist to find a song fast. Tap it to play the playlist from there.
Swiping the app away from recent apps now stops the music.
New Playlists tab at the bottom: make as many named playlists as you like.
Add songs one at a time with search, or every song from a channel at once.
Drag to reorder, ✕ to remove a song, and rename or delete a playlist from the ⋮ menu.
Shuffle a playlist, or play it in order. Tap a song to play in order from there.
Playlists are saved on your phone.

notes: Updated: the built-in song list now has 347 songs.
details: The song list built into the app (used when you open it with no signal) now has 347 songs.
Behind-the-scenes cleanup. Nothing else looks or works differently.
Volume leveling now works even when you open the app with no or slow signal.
Brand-new songs are leveled right away.
The volume holds steadier at the start of a song.
Removed the "Allow notifications" banner. The playback controls work without that permission.

notes: New: artwork and a draggable progress bar in the media player.
details: The song's artwork now shows in the notification and on the lock screen.
The media player shows the song's time and a progress bar.
Drag the progress bar to skip around in the song.

notes: Fixed: tapping the music notification could open another app.
details: Tapping VspoM's music notification now always opens VspoM, not another app like Twitter or YouTube.

notes: New: the app can now update itself.
details: When a new version is out, the app asks you when you open it.
Tap Update to download it, then Install. The permissions you granted are kept.
Tap Later and it asks again next time.
